summary: Day: top-of-upper-deck game-day panorama (2018). Night: 2023 upper-deck portrait shot.

files.author: Bluesnote

files.note: Wide panorama from the top row of the upper deck during the 2018 Michigan game, full crowd; field rows ~560-960 of 1042 (54-92%), stands and Tyser Tower press box rows ~380-560, campus skyline and cloudy sky in the top ~35%; railing and fans in the lower corners. Field sits low: needs a downward offset

files.note: Portrait night shot from the upper deck at a 2023 game, across the 50 to the press-box side; field rows ~1750-2550 of 3200 (55-80%), stands and press box rows ~950-1750, lit sky and light towers in the top ~30%, upper-deck fans in the bottom ~20%
